metadata.description: JapanFold: hosted biomolecular structure prediction, binder design and protein embeddings on Tenstorrent.

plugins.name: japanfold
plugins.description: Predict 3D biomolecular structures and binding affinity (Boltz-2, ESMFold-2, OpenFold3, OpenBind-0, RoseTTAFold3, OpenDDE, AF2-IG and Mol-1), score a designed binder against its target, design de-novo binders and proteins (BoltzGen, RFdiffusion3, PXDesign and RFD4-Proteina), scaffold a functional motif around a pasted structure, and compute protein-language-model embeddings (ESMC and SaProt) via JapanFold, a hosted, Tenstorrent-accelerated HTTP API in Japan. Use to fold a protein or complex, co-fold a protein with a ligand and get affinity, design nanobody/antibody/peptide/miniprotein binders against a target, turn a sequence into a PDB/mmCIF structure, or get a fixed-size embedding vector for search/clustering/ML features, whenever a hosted service is fine. Needs a JapanFold API key; no local GPU.
